name: Can re-stucco improve my home's insulation and energy efficiency?

mainEntity.name: Can re-stucco improve my home's insulation and energy efficiency?

acceptedAnswer.text: Re-stucco can contribute to improved home insulation and energy efficiency, depending on the materials and methods used. While stucco itself provides some insulative properties, applying a new stucco system often involves repairing any existing cracks or gaps in the exterior. These repairs prevent air leakage, which is a major source of energy loss. Additionally, if an exterior insulation and finish system (EIFS) or an additional layer of insulation is incorporated beneath the new stucco, it can significantly enhance your home's thermal performance and reduce heating and cooling costs.
acceptedAnswer.description: Re-stucco can improve insulation by sealing cracks and gaps, and energy efficiency can be further enhanced if additional insulation or an EIFS system is integrated during the process.
